summary.text: Minnie Gonzalez was elected to represent the 3rd House District in 1996.

paragraphs.text: She was born in Adjuntas, Puerto Rico, graduated from Adjuntas High School and migrated to the United States in 1981.
She was elected a Town Committee member in 1986 and previously worked as a special deputy sheriff at West Hartford Superior Court and as an assistant registrar of voters.
